args.subject: Invitation: Tuesday Evening Book Club — 7 PM at the Local Library
args.body:
Hi Henry,

I’d like to invite you to join our book club meetings on Tuesday evenings. We meet at 7:00 PM at the local library and are currently reading mystery novels. We’d love to have you come along — feel free to drop in any Tuesday.

Please let me know if you can make it or if you have any questions.

Thanks,

args.subject: Recommendation: The Artisan Bakery downtown
args.body:
Hi Alice,

I wanted to recommend The Artisan Bakery downtown — their sourdough bread is incredible. They bake fresh every morning at 6:00 AM.

Thought you might enjoy trying it!

Best,
[Your Name]

args.subject: Invitation: Hands-on Italian Cooking Class (Wednesday evening)
args.body:
Hi Bob,

I hope you’re doing well. I’d like to invite you to a hands-on Italian cuisine cooking class at the Culinary Arts Center next week on Wednesday evening. It’s a great, small-group session where we’ll learn classic Italian dishes and cook together.

Would you be able to join? If so, I can send more details (time, cost, and registration information).

Thanks,

args.subject: Recommendation: Rachel, Yoga Instructor
args.body:
Hi Charlie,

I wanted to recommend Rachel — she’s an excellent yoga instructor who teaches at the community center on Tuesdays and Thursdays. Her classes are well-paced and suitable for all levels. I think you’d really enjoy her sessions.

Best,
